The score helps clinicians and researchers classify the likelihood of an adverse drug reaction (ADR) as doubtful, possible, probable, or definite. Sometimes the user might not have provided all the information, so you will need to ask for the missing information (remember to give them the option to say "unknown" if they don't know the answer). Returns: JSON string with score, probability category, and detailed breakdown
